ayurveda_history_title: Hela Wedakama - Sri Lankan Traditional Medicine
ayurveda_history_desc: Sri Lanka has its own indigenous scheme of traditional medicine called &quot;Hela wedakama&quot;. This system has been practiced for many centuries in our island nation. The Sri Lankan Ayurvedic tradition is a unique mixture of Sinhala traditional medicine, Ayurveda and Siddha systems of India, and most importantly, the Desheeya Chikitsa - the indigenous medicine of Sri Lanka.
